title: H2C Material Selector runtime database (dist/db.json)
description: The contract between the build and the offline application. build/src/contract.js validates every build against it; a renamed, removed, retyped or unexpected field in a record fails the build. Nested analysis objects (print summaries, gates, estimates, model diagnostics) are typed at their top level only.

release.description: The release this database is (build/src/release.js, D96): a digest of the tables, schema, rules, engine and locked dependencies, and its twelve-character ID. Absent only where a tool builds the database without the build entry point.

knowHow.description: Makers' know-how, counted (build/src/know-how.js): the topics in panel order, the statements, products and materials by know-how state, and how many sources were read or searched.

meta.description: estimateCoverage, estimateModel, printEstimates and estimateTally are written by the estimate stage and absent from a core build (--no-estimates).

estimate.description: The grade's own estimate per headline (D81): added by the estimate stage, absent from the core build. It decides nothing.

headline.description: The product's own value per headline, by rule (re-center phase 1); absent for a retired grade.

knowHow.description: What the product's maker says beyond the numbers, as a state (build/src/know-how.js): collected, searched with nothing published, sheet silent, or no document read; its statements per topic (db.knowHow holds them); when its documents were read and its maker's site searched; and the same states for the chamber, drying and annealing parts of its print recipe. Absent for a retired grade.

Makers' know-how: each statement a maker's document prints about printing and using its product beyond the numbers, in its own words, from evidence.csv rows whose topic is in the know-how category. Kept out of db.evidence, so no criterion, screen or count reads one; the product panel shows them.

anneal.description: The annealing schedule (Anneal °C, Anneal h), or null when not annealed.

testTemperatureC.description: The test temperature in °C from the typed column Test temperature °C (m175); absent where the source states none as a number.

printGuide.description: A printer maker's filament guide, one entry per type it heads a column with (data/tables/print_guide.csv, D88): its recipe read as a profile's, and the materials it speaks for with why. Read for a product only where its own profiles and its twin's are silent on a part of its print gate; never a product's profile.

polymers.description: The polymer identities the estimate stage knows (data/tables/polymers.csv).

polymerEnvironment.description: The published environmental behaviour of base polymers (data/tables/polymer_environment.csv), one row per polymer, category and agent. Present only when the table has rows (D64).

polymerEvidence.description: Inferred environment records: for each candidate material and each category where it has no record of its own, its base polymer's published behaviour, with the category verdict derived by D64's rule. Shown, may screen under inference, never passes. Present only when polymerEnvironment is.

knowHowState.description: collected: at least one statement (or, for a recipe part, a stated value); searched-nothing: the maker's site was searched and gave nothing; sheet-silent: the product's documents were read and gave nothing, the site not yet searched; no-document-read: none of its documents was read.

lowerBounds.description: Measurements of a material that bound this headline from below, or null.

unstatedDirection.description: Whether a value whose source states no direction is this headline's as published (D84) or no value of it (D92); null where the headline has no direction.

notch.description: The notch a backing impact measurement must state (D92), or null.

testTemperatureC.description: The test temperature the headline is defined at (D92); a value stated at another is no value of it. Null: any.

standard.description: The test standard a backing measurement that names one must name (D94), or null: any.

comparisonNote.description: What the headline compares and why its related values that are not its own are left out, shown beside them in the drawer (D92), or null.

headlineProducts.description: A material's headline where its products publish comparably (D83): their median, spread and typical product (build/src/products.js). Decides nothing; the engine judges the products.

twins.description: How many of the n values are a twin's reading of its sibling's sheet (D89); absent when none.

estimateIdentity.description: The polymers row the estimate stage treats the material as.

variantClass.description: A declared commercial variant class (silk, particle-filled).

polymer.description: The material's inferred polymer-level records in db.polymerEvidence (D64). Present only when the polymer_environment table has rows.

summary.description: The material's spread per headline across its products (re-center phase 1); absent for a family entry.

knowHow.description: Makers' know-how across the material's products (build/src/know-how.js): its state (collected if any product has a statement), its products by state, how many makers make them, per topic how many makers and products have a statement, statements on the material itself, how many of its products' makers' sites were searched, and its products by state for each part of the print recipe. Absent for a family entry.

interval.description: What a measurement asserts: a point, a symmetric uncertainty, a published range, or a bound from a > or < operator (one end null, with whether the bound itself is excluded).

productValue.description: A product's own value for one headline, chosen by rule (build/src/products.js, re-center phase 1): the measurement, its evidence level (comparable, or as published where the source leaves the direction or the load unstated), and what qualifies it. The source and conditions are the measurement's. A price is the median of the product's own sample listings. It decides nothing until the engine reads products (phase 2).

from.description: Present where the product publishes nothing for this headline and a twin does (D89): the sibling whose own value this is, an active product of the same material under the same formulation key, and the label a reader is shown. The measurement is the sibling's.

productPrint.description: A product's own print recipe (build/src/products.js): the gate across its own profiles for each axis and the window of the profile that decided it, whether it wants an enclosure, a hardened nozzle and drying, and the annealing its sheets state for values measured on annealed parts. Never a union across a material's products. Where its own profiles are silent on a part, its twin's (D89) and, for the print gate's parts, its material's printer maker's guide (D88) are read, and `from` says which part came from where.

from.description: The parts of the recipe the product's own profiles are silent on and that were read elsewhere: a twin's sheet (D89) or its material's printer maker's guide (D88). Absent when every part is its own.

headlineSummary.description: A material's spread for one headline across its procurement products that are not declared variants (build/src/products.js, D83 decided): how many products, how many publish a comparable value, their range, quartiles (from four values) and the typical product (nearest the median); values published without the direction or load, and variants, counted apart. The spread of products, never uncertainty about one.

twins.description: How many of the comparable values are a twin's reading of its sibling's sheet (D89); absent when none.
